Reel Remix · free, in your browser

Automatic video editor: an edit from your clips

Drop a pile of clips and photos and Reel Remix cuts them into an edit for you: a target length, a pace, split-screen grids that switch, effects and a soundtrack. Press Reshuffle for another take.

Open Reel Remix

How to do it

  1. Open Reel Remix and drop your clips and photos on Clips and photos.
  2. Pick the Export preset: Phone vertical 1080×1920, Square, Landscape 1920×1080, 4K or Portrait.
  3. Set the Target length and the Pace, and choose a Layout or a random grid.
  4. Press Remix. Not quite right? Press Reshuffle for a new seed, or lock the cuts you want to keep.
  5. Press Export to record the video in the page, or Send to SlopCut to fine-tune it on a timeline.

Every edit comes from a seed shown as eight characters. The same seed with the same clips and options gives exactly the same edit, so a version you like is never lost.

Your files stay on this device: Reel Remix runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

What format is the exported video?

WebM, or MP4 where your browser can record it. The export plays the edit in real time while it records, so keep the tab visible until it finishes.

Can I add music?

Yes. Set Audio to Music and press Pick music file, or use the sound of one of your clips. The music fades out over the last 2 seconds.

Are my clips uploaded?

No. The edit is planned, previewed and recorded in your browser, and the clips stay on your device.
